## Abstract

To be written after the first empirical results are frozen. The abstract will distinguish descriptive evidence from causal estimates.

## 1. Introduction

Core question: what happens to the economic value of being locally competent when technology successively removes geographic scarcity and then reduces the scarcity of competent output itself?

The paper's empirical contribution will be stated only after the Wave 1 identification design is executed.
